vulnerability.name: USN-5705-1
vulnerability.description: Chintan Shah discovered that LibTIFF incorrectly handled memory in certain conditions. An attacker could trick a user into processing a specially crafted image file and potentially use this issue to allow for information disclosure or to cause the application to crash. (CVE-2022-3570)  It was discovered that LibTIFF incorrectly handled memory in certain conditions. An attacker could trick a user into processing a specially crafted tiff file and potentially use this issue to cause a denial of service. (CVE-2022-3598)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in LibTIFF. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
